Application Data.NAME: Blooming Creations Florist
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Blooming Creations Florist specializes in providing a wide selection of fresh and artificial floral arrangements for various occasions, including weddings, corporate events, and everyday celebrations. Our operations include a brick-and-mortar retail shop with a climate-controlled storage area for inventory, ensuring the integrity and quality of our products. We offer basic floral design and consultation services, focusing primarily on product sales while maintaining a documented low-claims history. Our delivery services are managed with safety protocols, and we adhere to best practices in care and maintenance of all floral products.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES:
On 03/15/2023, a delivery vehicle was involved in a minor accident due to slippery road conditions after a rainstorm while transporting floral arrangements to a corporate event. The damages amounted to $1,000 and were fully covered by our existing vehicle insurance. This claim has been resolved, and the status is closed. 

No other losses or claims have been reported in the past three years.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Sunday, Closed
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade I, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security system with surveillance cameras and nightly patrols by a licensed security service.
